content: Hello, you've reached Amazon Account Security. This is Brian speaking. How may I assist you today?
Hi Brian, I got a message saying there were purchases on my account that I didn't make. I think my son might have clicked something by accident.

I understand your concern. Don't worry, I'm here to help you sort this out and ensure your account remains secure. Can you please confirm your full name and the email associated with your Amazon account?
Sure. My name is Laura Simmons and the email is laura.simmons123@gmail.com.
Thank you, Laura. I'm going to check the recent activity for you. While I look, can you confirm the best phone number to reach you, in case we get disconnected?

Alright, I see some purchases flagged as suspicious and some access attempts from outside your usual locations. To fully secure your account, have you noticed any unfamiliar emails or charges on your bank statement?
I haven't checked my bank yet. Should I be worried? What should I do?

It's good that you reached out quickly. To protect your funds, we sometimes see scammers attempt to use saved payment methods to move money out. I'll guide you through the steps to secure your account and prevent further unauthorized charges.
Alright, please tell me what to do. I'm really anxious about this.

I understand, Laura. First, I need to verify your most recent bank transactions. Could you log into your online banking and let me know if you see any payments to Amazon or any other online retailers that you don't recognize?
Okay, give me a minute. I'm logging in now.
Take your time. Please stay on the line while you check. If you see anything unusual, let me know right away.
There's a charge for $249 from Amazon yesterday. I definitely didn't order anything that expensive.

Thank you for telling me. That is one of the unauthorized purchases we had flagged. Because your Amazon account and your bank account may be compromised, we need to move your remaining funds to a secure, government-regulated holding account until we complete our investigation.
Wait, you want me to move my money? Is that really necessary?

I understand it sounds concerning, but this process is standard protocol to protect account holders from ongoing fraud. I have authorization to walk you through transferring your balance into a temporary safe account under your name.
How do I do that? I've never done something like this before.
No problem, I'll guide you through every step. First, please tell me the name of your bank and whether you use online banking via mobile app or computer.
I bank with First Federal and I usually use the app on my phone.

Thank you. Now, I'll provide you with the secure account details. When you're ready, let me know so I can give you the routing and account number for the protected account where your funds will be temporarily held.
Okay, I'm ready. Is this definitely safe?

Absolutely, Laura. This is an FDIC-insured holding account used specifically for fraud protection cases. Please open your banking app and select the option to send a wire transfer. I will provide you with the account information now.
Alright, I see the transfer option.
Great. Please enter the following routing number: 011401533, and the account number: 002987654321. For the account name, enter 'Amazon Security Holdings'. Let me know once you've typed these in.
I've entered all that, but it's asking for an amount. Should I transfer everything?
Yes, to ensure full protection, transfer your available balance. Once the investigation is complete, we'll return the funds immediately. Please confirm the exact amount before you send it.
My balance is $2,900. Should I type that in?
That's correct, Laura. Please enter $2,900.00 and double-check the recipient details. I'll wait while you complete the transfer. Let me know when it's done.
Okay, I just hit submit. It's saying it may take a few hours.

Thank you for acting quickly. I'll keep monitoring your account for any further activity. It's important that you don't log into your Amazon or banking account until you hear back from us, as it could reset the security measures we've put in place.
Alright, but will I get my money back soon?

Yes, as soon as the security check is complete, we will contact you and return your funds. If you have any questions or notice further suspicious activity, please call this number directly and refer to your case ID, which I'll text to you now.
